audience: Swedish hobby businesses that invoice clients and track payments in Hobok

useCases.title: Find open invoices and their totals
useCases.text: List invoices by status: sent, paid or credited. Open one for its lines, totals, status and the emails sent.

useCases.title: Issue an invoice to a saved customer
useCases.text: Issue a sent invoice for a saved customer or a one-off buyer. It takes the next invoice number, which cannot be reused.

useCases.title: Record a payment on a sent invoice
useCases.text: Mark a sent invoice as paid with a payment method. Hobok books the income for the year. Then queue the receipt email if the buyer needs it.

useCases.title: Keep saved customers and products up to date
useCases.text: Add a saved customer or a product with its price in SEK, so later invoices can use them.
